settings.title: MiaDonna Rewards
settings.subtitle: Earn rewards on every purchase and redeem them like cash toward future lab-grown diamond jewelry – because every purchase deserves a little more sparkle.

settings.html_content:
How It Works

MiaDonna Rewards is straightforward by design. Sign up for free, earn rewards every time you make a purchase, and spend them like cash on any future order. Every $20 you spend earns $1 in rewards toward your next purchase. Here's how it works in three steps:

settings.title: How do I join MiaDonna loyalty program?
settings.content: Joining MiaDonna Rewards is quick, easy and free! Simply create an account on our website and opt-in to the program. You will automatically start earning points with your first purchase!

settings.title: How do I earn points?
settings.content: ADJUST: You can earn points through various actions like making purchases, publishing product reviews, and following us on social media. Check the "Ways to Earn" section for details.

settings.title: How do I redeem my points?
settings.content: ADJUST: ORIGINAL: Log in to your account, go to the loyalty program section, and choose the reward you want to redeem. You'll receive a discount code or instructions on how to use your reward. NEW: Log in to your account, shop, and proceed to the checkout. During checkout, look for "Your Rewards Wallet" to see how many points you have and redeem your desired points toward your purchase.

settings.title: How long does it take to earn points?
settings.content: ADJUST: Points earned for actions - like publishing a review or following MiaDonna on social media - enter your points balance within a few minutes of completing the action. Points earned for purchases enter your points balance 61 days after your purchase is made, to give you our full 60-day return window to consider your purchase.

settings.title: Do any purchases not qualify for points?
settings.content: ADJUST: Points for purchases made with a discount code will be earned at the price paid post-discount, not including tax. Purchases of services like repair, resetting, or ring sizing do not earn points. Purchases under $20 do not earn points.

settings.title: Are there restrictions on how I can redeem my points?
settings.content: ADJUST: Each point you earn equals $1 to spend on a future MiaDonna purchase. No more than 2500 points can be redeemed per transaction. No more than 5000 total points can be earned in one rewards balance at one time.

settings.title: Do points expire?
settings.content: ADJUST: Points expire 365 days after they've entered your points balance. You'll receive an email notification when you are 7 days away from points expiring.

settings.title: Can I redeem my points in a gift with purchase transaction?
settings.content: ADJUST: If a gift with purchase happens to be available, you can redeem points and still earn a gift with purchase, if the points you redeem do not drop your price paid below the gift with purchase threshold. For example, if a gift with purchase is offered for purchases more than $3,000, and your order total is $3,100, you can redeem no more than 99 points toward your purchase to qualify for the gift with purchase.
